topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits China’s Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes
featured.summary: Search and rescue efforts under way after quake strikes region’s north, officials say, while at least seven aftershocks recorded A magnitude-7 earthquake has hit China’s Tibet region, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said. Search and rescue efforts continued after the collapse of at least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 中国西藏发生7级地震，造成至少16人死亡，数百座房屋倒塌
featured.summaryZh: 中国西藏那曲地区发生7级地震，导致至少16人死亡、54人受伤。当地政府正在进行搜救工作，目前已确认数百座房屋及牲畜棚倒塌。
featured.whyImportant: 此次地震造成了严重的人员伤亡和财产损失，引发了对受灾地区救援进展的广泛关注。

featured.title: ‘Saved my mum’s life’: Chinese cancer drug on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it
featured.summary: Global pharmaceutical firm AstraZeneca on Thursday said it would start selling a cancer drug after coming under criticism for failing to bring it to the US market faster, prompting some Americans to fly to Shanghai to procure the potentially life-saving medicine first developed by China. In recent months, desperate Americans have travelled to China to obtain the Chinese-made cancer drug that was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration but remained unavailable in the country for more than...
featured.titleZh: “救了我母亲的命”：中国抗癌药在美国上市，此前曾有美国人专程赴华购买
featured.summaryZh: 阿斯利康公司宣布开始在美国销售一款中国研发的抗癌药物。此前由于该药在美国上市缓慢，许多美国患者不得不前往上海购买以寻求救治。
featured.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了全球医药供应链的滞后性以及中国创新药物在国际市场上的重要性。

featured.titleZh: 洪都拉斯施压中国企业；超强台风“山竹”逼近台湾：南华早报七大要闻
featured.summaryZh: 洪都拉斯移民官员对当地中国商铺及中资建筑项目进行了检查，并对41名中国公民进行了审查。与此同时，超强台风“山竹”正向台湾方向移动。
featured.whyImportant: 这些新闻涵盖了地缘政治摩擦与自然灾害预警，反映了当前区域局势的复杂性。

featured.title: What do the protests in France look like from China? Internet users weigh in
featured.summary: Internet users in China are watching the protests in France with a mix of geopolitical cynicism, domestic pride and sadness at the damage to French landmarks. The protests started in September, when students and teachers in southeastern Paris rallied against deteriorating school conditions. Those specific grievances quickly escalated into nationwide protests at the rising cost of living and declining public services. What began as peaceful marches has since dissolved into violence, with rioters...
featured.titleZh: 中国网民如何看待法国抗议活动？
featured.summaryZh: 中国网民对法国的抗议活动表现出复杂的态度，包括地缘政治上的冷嘲热讽、对国内稳定的自豪感以及对法国地标受损的惋惜。抗议最初源于对教育条件的不满，随后演变为针对生活成本和公共服务的全国性骚乱。
featured.whyImportant: 中国公众对法国社会动荡的舆论反应，折射出不同文化背景下对社会治理与抗议活动的认知差异。

featured.title: China urges opening Bab al-Mandeb in first joint statement with regional nation
featured.summary: In its first formal statement with a Red Sea nation on the fallout from the US-Iran war, China said in a joint communique with Djibouti that it backs “constructive efforts” to ensure international shipping lanes are safe and open. The statement on Thursday was released a day after Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and his Djiboutian counterpart Abdoulkader Houssein Omar met in Beijing. “The two sides emphasised the importance of safeguarding freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the Bab...
featured.titleZh: 中国在与地区国家的首份联合声明中敦促开放曼德海峡
featured.summaryZh: 中国与吉布提发表联合公报，强调维护红海航行自由的重要性。这是中国首次就美伊战争引发的航运安全问题与红海国家发表正式声明。
featured.whyImportant: 此举显示中国正积极参与地区安全事务，并试图在红海航运危机中发挥建设性作用。

featured.title: HSBC RedCoin stablecoin launches for 3.3 million PayMe users in Hong Kong
featured.summary: HSBC will launch its Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin in stages from Friday for more than 3.3 million users of its PayMe app, as the bank pushes to bring digital currencies into the city’s mainstream retail and investment markets. HSBC RedCoin, available only through PayMe and the bank’s Hong Kong mobile banking app, would initially support peer-to-peer transfers and peer-to-merchant payments on PayMe, according to head of PayMe Lawrence Li. Users can activate their HSBC RedCoin wallet, with...
featured.titleZh: 汇丰银行RedCoin稳定币向香港330万PayMe用户推出
featured.summaryZh: 汇丰银行将从周五起向其PayMe应用的330多万用户分阶段推出港元稳定币。该稳定币初期将支持PayMe平台内的点对点转账及商户支付功能。
featured.whyImportant: 此举标志着传统银行在推动数字货币进入主流零售和投资市场方面迈出了重要一步。

featured.title: Hong Kong, Beijing slam UK report’s ‘smears’ over national security law
featured.summary: Hong Kong and mainland Chinese authorities have condemned a UK report that said the city’s national security law had further eroded the openness underpinning its success as a financial hub. In a statement issued in the early hours of Friday, the Hong Kong government said it must “refute the untruthful remarks, slanders and smears” about the city in London’s report and reject what it described as an attempt to interfere in its governance through “despicable political manoeuvres”. “The UK...
featured.titleZh: 香港与北京抨击英国报告对国家安全法的“抹黑”
featured.summaryZh: 香港及中国内地当局严厉谴责英国一份指责香港国安法削弱金融中心开放性的报告。港府称该报告包含不实言论，并拒绝接受其对香港治理的干预。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了中国与西方国家在香港治理及法治问题上的持续外交摩擦。

featured.title: Could US advances in drone command give it an edge over the PLA in a Taiwan conflict?
featured.summary: From the cockpit of an F-22 fighter to an aircraft carrier sailing in the Pacific, the US military is showing new ways to command uncrewed aircraft over vast distances. The United States disclosed two tests this month as Washington seeks to outpace Beijing in a technology contest that could redefine air and naval power in the region. Illustrating US military advances and their potential significance for a Taiwan conflict, an F-22 pilot controlled an autonomous YFQ-44A combat drone during flight,...
featured.titleZh: 美国在无人机指挥方面的进展能否使其在台海冲突中获得对解放军的优势？
featured.summaryZh: 美国军方近期测试了远程指挥无人机的新技术，包括F-22飞行员控制自主战斗无人机。华盛顿正寻求通过技术领先，在区域军事竞争中占据优势。
featured.whyImportant: 无人机指挥技术的突破可能改变未来印太地区的军事力量平衡，对台海局势具有潜在影响。

global.title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up
global.summary: Israeli pogroms on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season intensify.
global.titleZh: 以色列在西岸逮捕36名巴勒斯坦人，针对农民的袭击加剧
global.summaryZh: 在橄榄收获季节，以色列针对巴勒斯坦农民及其土地的暴力行为正在加剧。此次逮捕行动进一步恶化了当地紧张局势。
global.whyImportant: 该事件反映了西岸地区日益严峻的安全局势及巴以冲突对平民生计的持续影响。

global.title: ‘I am not resigning’: embattled leader digs in as Malaysia royal crisis deepens
global.summary: Embattled Negeri Sembilan chief minister Ismail Lasim has denied claims that he has resigned, as a constitutional crisis in the Malaysian state spiralled further following a move by his executive council to challenge their sacking by the state’s ruler in court. The state has been all but paralysed by a dispute that began in April over who has the right to sit on Negeri Sembilan’s throne, bringing down a state government aligned with Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ruling Pakatan Harapan (PH)...
global.titleZh: “我不会辞职”：马来西亚森美兰州政治危机加深，领导人拒绝下台
global.summaryZh: 森美兰州州务大臣伊斯梅尔·拉辛否认辞职传闻，该州因王位继承争议引发的宪法危机持续发酵。州行政会议挑战州统治者的解职决定，导致州政府陷入瘫痪。
global.whyImportant: 这场宪法危机不仅导致地方政府运作停滞，还对马来西亚的政治稳定构成了挑战。

global.title: UK consumer confidence falls at fastest rate since Covid as cost of living bites
global.summary: Economic fallout from war in Middle East adds to pressures on consumers and on chancellor before budget Consumer confidence in the UK has fallen at the fastest rate outside the Covid pandemic since the 2016 Brexit vote as the escalating economic damage from the war in the Middle East hits Britain. With less than a week before John Healey’s first budget, the latest barometer from the data company GfK indicated confidence plunged by 11 percentage points in October to -24 amid pressure on consumers from the rising cost of living. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 英国消费者信心降至疫情以来最低点，生活成本压力加剧
global.summaryZh: 受中东战争带来的经济影响，英国消费者信心指数大幅下跌。在财政预算案公布前，生活成本的上升正对英国经济造成沉重压力。
global.whyImportant: 消费者信心的下滑预示着英国经济面临严峻挑战，并可能影响政府即将出台的财政政策。

global.title: Trump blasts basketball star LeBron James for not standing still during US anthem
global.summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday accused LeBron James of disrespecting the United States after the NBA star appeared to continue his warm-ups while the national anthem was performed before Philadelphia’s season opener on Tuesday. “I said right from the beginning that he’s no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE,” Trump said of James in a social media post sharing the video. “LeBron James should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag, and all that our...
global.titleZh: 特朗普抨击篮球明星勒布朗·詹姆斯在奏国歌时未站立
global.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普指责NBA球星勒布朗·詹姆斯在奏国歌时继续热身，称其行为不尊重美国。特朗普在社交媒体上要求詹姆斯向阵亡将士道歉。
global.whyImportant: 此事件再次引发了关于体育界人士在国歌仪式中表达政治立场及爱国主义定义的社会争议。

global.title: Trump tells Iowa rally crowd he encouraged Ramaswamy to keep running widely criticized campaign ad – as it happened
global.summary: This live blog is now closed. Sign up for the Breaking News US email Trump attacks Ohio governor over call for Ramaswamy to drop ‘deeply troubling’ ad Reporting from Anchorage, Alaska Mary Peltola’s campaign to represent Alaska in the US Senate has taken her to parts of the massive state’s interior that are inaccessible by road and on the frontlines of the cost-of-living crisis she hopes will make her the first Democrat to win the seat in nearly two decades. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 特朗普在艾奥瓦州集会上称鼓励拉马斯瓦米继续投放备受争议的竞选广告
global.summaryZh: 特朗普在集会上表示支持拉马斯瓦米继续投放引发批评的竞选广告。与此同时，阿拉斯加州的参议员竞选正聚焦于生活成本危机。
global.whyImportant: 特朗普对争议性竞选策略的支持反映了其在党内竞选中的影响力及对舆论导向的掌控。

global.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine’s Starlink access amid Russia war
global.summary: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.
global.titleZh: 特朗普称马斯克在俄乌战争期间恢复了乌克兰的星链访问权限
global.summaryZh: 乌克兰在军事行动中依赖星链系统。尽管马斯克多次否认限制过访问权限，但特朗普公开声称其恢复了该服务。
global.whyImportant: 此言论涉及关键军事通信技术在冲突中的使用，并引发了关于马斯克在俄乌战争中角色及影响力的讨论。

global.title: Hong Kong degree holders’ pay advantage over non-graduates narrows to HK$2,500
global.summary: Fresh Hong Kong graduates are increasingly feeling the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) as they enter the workforce, human resources experts have said, after a survey found the starting salaries for degree holders and sub-degree graduates had narrowed. The results of the latest annual survey by Baptist University found the disparity between the starting salaries of bachelor’s degree and sub-degree graduates narrowed by 17 per cent, or HK$500 (US$63.70), from HK$3,000 last year to HK$2,500...
global.titleZh: 香港学位持有者与非学位持有者的薪资差距缩小至2500港元
global.summaryZh: 人力资源专家指出，人工智能对香港应届毕业生的就业市场产生了影响。浸会大学的年度调查显示，学士学位与副学位毕业生的起薪差距已从去年的3000港元缩小至2500港元。
global.whyImportant: 薪资差距的缩小反映了就业市场结构的变化以及人工智能对初级岗位薪酬水平的潜在影响。

global.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
global.summary: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.
global.titleZh: “这太卑鄙了”：艾米·阿克顿回应共和党对手利用其疏远母亲制作的攻击性广告
global.summaryZh: 共和党候选人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米发布了一则竞选广告，其中涉及阿克顿疏远的母亲。该母亲的丈夫曾被指控在阿克顿童年时期对其进行性虐待。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于竞选策略道德边界的讨论，并可能影响选民对候选人品格的看法。

usa.title: El Salvador deploys special forces to Haiti after soldiers seized by gangs
usa.summary: El Salvador deployed 100 special forces soldiers to Haiti on Thursday to help rescue four missing soldiers from the Central American country who recently came under attack by gangs, two officials told Associated Press. The special forces arrived a day after Salvadorean President Nayib Bukele announced a military operation to rescue the four aviation technicians, issuing an ultimatum directly to Haitian gang leaders in Creole. “We have a single objective: to bring our four compatriots back home...
usa.titleZh: 萨尔瓦多向海地部署特种部队，此前四名士兵遭帮派扣押
usa.summaryZh: 萨尔瓦多总统布克尔宣布开展军事行动，向海地派遣100名特种兵以营救四名被帮派扣押的航空技术人员。萨方已向海地帮派首领发出最后通牒，要求确保人员安全回国。
usa.whyImportant: 此次跨境军事行动凸显了海地安全局势的恶化以及萨尔瓦多政府对保护海外公民的强硬立场。

usa.title: What will Trump do if he loses in November? Your questions answered – podcast
usa.summary: Will Donald Trump accept a ‘blue wave’ if it happens? Have young people turned away from centrist politics for ever? Will the US ever recover its image on the world stage? Jonathan Freedland is joined by the Guardian US columnist Moira Donegan to answer these questions and more Buy your tickets to the Guardian’s post-midterms live event, hosted by Jonathan Freedland Watch Jonathan Freedland on our new Politics Weekly YouTube channel Send your questions and feedback to politicsweeklyamerica@theguardian.com Watch Stateside’s episode on attacks on voter rights in the US Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 如果特朗普在十一月落败会怎样？为您解答疑问——播客
usa.summaryZh: 《卫报》播客探讨了特朗普若在选举中失利是否会接受结果，以及美国年轻人对中间派政治的态度。节目还讨论了美国在国际舞台上的形象恢复问题。
usa.whyImportant: 该讨论反映了美国当前政治极化背景下，公众对选举公正性及国家未来走向的深层忧虑。

usa.summary: MEMORANDUM FOR THE SECRETARY OF WAR SUBJECT: Presidential Determination Pursuant to Section 303 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as Amended, on Domestic Petroleum Production, Refining, and Logistics Capacity On January 20, 2025, I issued Executive Order 14156 (Declaring a National Energy Emergency), under the National Emergencies Act. usa.titleZh: 关于根据修订后的1950年《国防生产法》第303条，就国内石油生产、炼油和物流能力作出的总统决定
usa.summaryZh: 美国总统发布备忘录，旨在根据《国防生产法》加强国内石油生产、炼油及物流能力。此举与2025年1月宣布的国家能源紧急状态相关。
usa.whyImportant: 此举显示美国政府正通过动用战时法律手段，试图解决国内能源安全与供应保障问题。

usa.title: Could US advances in drone command give it an edge over the PLA in a Taiwan conflict?
usa.summary: From the cockpit of an F-22 fighter to an aircraft carrier sailing in the Pacific, the US military is showing new ways to command uncrewed aircraft over vast distances. The United States disclosed two tests this month as Washington seeks to outpace Beijing in a technology contest that could redefine air and naval power in the region. Illustrating US military advances and their potential significance for a Taiwan conflict, an F-22 pilot controlled an autonomous YFQ-44A combat drone during flight,...
usa.titleZh: 美国在无人机指挥方面的进展能否使其在台海冲突中获得对解放军的优势？
usa.summaryZh: 美国军方近期测试了远程指挥无人机的新技术，包括F-22飞行员控制自主战斗无人机。华盛顿正寻求通过技术领先，在区域军事竞争中占据优势。
usa.whyImportant: 无人机指挥技术的突破可能改变未来印太地区的军事力量平衡，对台海局势具有潜在影响。

usa.title: Brazil’s election and the battle for the Amazon – podcast
usa.summary: Our Latin America correspondent, Tom Phillips, heads to Roraima to hear what’s at stake for the rainforest and the communities that live there in the Brazilian presidential runoff on Sunday. Send your comments and questions to tif.questions@theguardian.com For the Amazon and the communities who live there, the stakes in Sunday’s Brazilian presidential election runoff could scarcely be higher. Our Latin America correspondent, Tom Phillips heads to Roraima, the country’s most northern state, to hear from voters, preachers and politicians in a region that heavily backed Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 巴西大选与亚马逊雨林的争夺战——播客
usa.summaryZh: 《卫报》记者前往巴西罗赖马州，探讨即将到来的总统大选决选对亚马逊雨林及当地社区的影响。该地区在首轮投票中曾大力支持博索纳罗。
usa.whyImportant: 巴西大选的结果将直接决定亚马逊雨林的保护政策及全球气候治理的走向。

watch.title: Australia sanctions 2 over North Korean fake IT workers scheme for nuclear funds
watch.summary: Australia said on Friday it had sanctioned two North Korean individuals and companies over the use of “fraudulent” IT workers and cybercrime to earn cash for the isolated nuclear-armed state. The two men are alleged to be key operators in Pyongyang’s cybercriminal activities overseas, estimated by analysts to bring in billions for the country’s weapons programme. “The North Korean entities and individuals sanctioned today facilitate North Korea’s use of fraudulent IT workers to raise revenue for...
watch.titleZh: 澳大利亚制裁两名涉嫌为朝鲜核计划筹资的虚假IT工作者
watch.summaryZh: 澳大利亚宣布制裁两名朝鲜个人及相关实体，指控其利用虚假IT工作和网络犯罪为朝鲜核武器计划筹集资金。据分析，这些活动每年为朝鲜带来数十亿美元收入。
watch.whyImportant: 此举旨在切断朝鲜非法资金链，加大对朝鲜核武器开发计划的国际制裁压力。

watch.title: ‘I’ve killed people’: Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly confessed to friend and asked for help cleaning ‘mess’, court told
watch.summary: Friend tells jury Lamarre-Condon told him in early 2024 ‘I shot the first one through the head and the second one through the door’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly confessed to killing two men, telling his friend it was an “out-of-body experience”, before attempting to play it off as a joke, a court has been told. Lamarre-Condon, 31, is accused of fatally shooting couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
watch.titleZh: 法庭获悉：博·拉马尔-康登据称向朋友承认“我杀人了”，并请求清理“烂摊子”
watch.summaryZh: 法庭审理显示，前警官博·拉马尔-康登被控使用警用武器杀害两名男子。被告曾向朋友描述作案细节，并试图将其掩盖为玩笑。
watch.whyImportant: 此案因涉及警务人员暴力犯罪，在澳大利亚引发了关于警察权力与公共安全的广泛关注。

watch.title: Rare Suu Kyi phone call to son signals shift in Myanmar junta strategy
watch.summary: The son of Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi said she sounded “fairly healthy” after speaking to the detained ex-democratic leader on Thursday for the first time in more than five years. Suu Kyi, 81, is under house arrest in the capital, Naypyidaw, according to Myanmar authorities, where she has been sequestered since being unseated in a 2021 military coup. “She was sounding fairly healthy,” Kim Aris, who lives in the UK, said after the telephone conversation. It was the first time he had spoken to his...
watch.titleZh: 昂山素季罕见致电其子，释放出缅甸军政府策略转变的信号
watch.summaryZh: 被软禁五年多的缅甸前领导人昂山素季与其子进行了电话交谈，称其身体状况尚可。这是自2021年政变以来，她首次与外界亲属通话。
watch.whyImportant: 此次通话可能暗示缅甸军政府在面对国际压力时，正尝试调整其对昂山素季的管控策略。

items.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits China’s Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes
items.summary: Search and rescue efforts under way after quake strikes region’s north, officials say, while at least seven aftershocks recorded A magnitude-7 earthquake has hit China’s Tibet region, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said. Search and rescue efforts continued after the collapse of at least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 中国西藏发生7级地震，造成至少16人死亡，数百座房屋倒塌
items.summaryZh: 中国西藏那曲地区发生7级地震，导致至少16人死亡、54人受伤。当地政府正在进行搜救工作，目前已确认数百座房屋及牲畜棚倒塌。
items.whyImportant: 此次地震造成了严重的人员伤亡和财产损失，引发了对受灾地区救援进展的广泛关注。

items.title: ‘Saved my mum’s life’: Chinese cancer drug on sale in US after Americans travel to buy it
items.summary: Global pharmaceutical firm AstraZeneca on Thursday said it would start selling a cancer drug after coming under criticism for failing to bring it to the US market faster, prompting some Americans to fly to Shanghai to procure the potentially life-saving medicine first developed by China. In recent months, desperate Americans have travelled to China to obtain the Chinese-made cancer drug that was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration but remained unavailable in the country for more than...
items.titleZh: “救了我母亲的命”：中国抗癌药在美国上市，此前曾有美国人专程赴华购买
items.summaryZh: 阿斯利康公司宣布开始在美国销售一款中国研发的抗癌药物。此前由于该药在美国上市缓慢，许多美国患者不得不前往上海购买以寻求救治。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了全球医药供应链的滞后性以及中国创新药物在国际市场上的重要性。

items.titleZh: 洪都拉斯施压中国企业；超强台风“山竹”逼近台湾：南华早报七大要闻
items.summaryZh: 洪都拉斯移民官员对当地中国商铺及中资建筑项目进行了检查，并对41名中国公民进行了审查。与此同时，超强台风“山竹”正向台湾方向移动。
items.whyImportant: 这些新闻涵盖了地缘政治摩擦与自然灾害预警，反映了当前区域局势的复杂性。

items.title: What do the protests in France look like from China? Internet users weigh in
items.summary: Internet users in China are watching the protests in France with a mix of geopolitical cynicism, domestic pride and sadness at the damage to French landmarks. The protests started in September, when students and teachers in southeastern Paris rallied against deteriorating school conditions. Those specific grievances quickly escalated into nationwide protests at the rising cost of living and declining public services. What began as peaceful marches has since dissolved into violence, with rioters...
items.titleZh: 中国网民如何看待法国抗议活动？
items.summaryZh: 中国网民对法国的抗议活动表现出复杂的态度，包括地缘政治上的冷嘲热讽、对国内稳定的自豪感以及对法国地标受损的惋惜。抗议最初源于对教育条件的不满，随后演变为针对生活成本和公共服务的全国性骚乱。
items.whyImportant: 中国公众对法国社会动荡的舆论反应，折射出不同文化背景下对社会治理与抗议活动的认知差异。

items.title: China urges opening Bab al-Mandeb in first joint statement with regional nation
items.summary: In its first formal statement with a Red Sea nation on the fallout from the US-Iran war, China said in a joint communique with Djibouti that it backs “constructive efforts” to ensure international shipping lanes are safe and open. The statement on Thursday was released a day after Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and his Djiboutian counterpart Abdoulkader Houssein Omar met in Beijing. “The two sides emphasised the importance of safeguarding freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the Bab...
items.titleZh: 中国在与地区国家的首份联合声明中敦促开放曼德海峡
items.summaryZh: 中国与吉布提发表联合公报，强调维护红海航行自由的重要性。这是中国首次就美伊战争引发的航运安全问题与红海国家发表正式声明。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示中国正积极参与地区安全事务，并试图在红海航运危机中发挥建设性作用。

items.title: HSBC RedCoin stablecoin launches for 3.3 million PayMe users in Hong Kong
items.summary: HSBC will launch its Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin in stages from Friday for more than 3.3 million users of its PayMe app, as the bank pushes to bring digital currencies into the city’s mainstream retail and investment markets. HSBC RedCoin, available only through PayMe and the bank’s Hong Kong mobile banking app, would initially support peer-to-peer transfers and peer-to-merchant payments on PayMe, according to head of PayMe Lawrence Li. items.titleZh: 汇丰银行RedCoin稳定币向香港330万PayMe用户推出
items.summaryZh: 汇丰银行将从周五起向其PayMe应用的330多万用户分阶段推出港元稳定币。该稳定币初期将支持PayMe平台内的点对点转账及商户支付功能。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着传统银行在推动数字货币进入主流零售和投资市场方面迈出了重要一步。

items.title: Hong Kong, Beijing slam UK report’s ‘smears’ over national security law
items.summary: Hong Kong and mainland Chinese authorities have condemned a UK report that said the city’s national security law had further eroded the openness underpinning its success as a financial hub. items.titleZh: 香港与北京抨击英国报告对国家安全法的“抹黑”
items.summaryZh: 香港及中国内地当局严厉谴责英国一份指责香港国安法削弱金融中心开放性的报告。港府称该报告包含不实言论，并拒绝接受其对香港治理的干预。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了中国与西方国家在香港治理及法治问题上的持续外交摩擦。

items.titleZh: 美国在无人机指挥方面的进展能否使其在台海冲突中获得对解放军的优势？

items.whyImportant: 无人机指挥技术的突破可能改变未来印太地区的军事力量平衡，对台海局势具有潜在影响。

items.title: Israel arrests 36 Palestinians in the West Bank, attacks on farmers ramp up
items.summary: Israeli pogroms on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season intensify.
items.titleZh: 以色列在西岸逮捕36名巴勒斯坦人，针对农民的袭击加剧
items.summaryZh: 在橄榄收获季节，以色列针对巴勒斯坦农民及其土地的暴力行为正在加剧。此次逮捕行动进一步恶化了当地紧张局势。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了西岸地区日益严峻的安全局势及巴以冲突对平民生计的持续影响。

items.title: ‘I am not resigning’: embattled leader digs in as Malaysia royal crisis deepens
items.summary: Embattled Negeri Sembilan chief minister Ismail Lasim has denied claims that he has resigned, as a constitutional crisis in the Malaysian state spiralled further following a move by his executive council to challenge their sacking by the state’s ruler in court. The state has been all but paralysed by a dispute that began in April over who has the right to sit on Negeri Sembilan’s throne, bringing down a state government aligned with Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ruling Pakatan Harapan (PH)...
items.titleZh: “我不会辞职”：马来西亚森美兰州政治危机加深，领导人拒绝下台
items.summaryZh: 森美兰州州务大臣伊斯梅尔·拉辛否认辞职传闻，该州因王位继承争议引发的宪法危机持续发酵。州行政会议挑战州统治者的解职决定，导致州政府陷入瘫痪。
items.whyImportant: 这场宪法危机不仅导致地方政府运作停滞，还对马来西亚的政治稳定构成了挑战。

items.title: UK consumer confidence falls at fastest rate since Covid as cost of living bites
items.summary: Economic fallout from war in Middle East adds to pressures on consumers and on chancellor before budget Consumer confidence in the UK has fallen at the fastest rate outside the Covid pandemic since the 2016 Brexit vote as the escalating economic damage from the war in the Middle East hits Britain. With less than a week before John Healey’s first budget, the latest barometer from the data company GfK indicated confidence plunged by 11 percentage points in October to -24 amid pressure on consumers from the rising cost of living. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国消费者信心降至疫情以来最低点，生活成本压力加剧
items.summaryZh: 受中东战争带来的经济影响，英国消费者信心指数大幅下跌。在财政预算案公布前，生活成本的上升正对英国经济造成沉重压力。
items.whyImportant: 消费者信心的下滑预示着英国经济面临严峻挑战，并可能影响政府即将出台的财政政策。

items.title: Trump blasts basketball star LeBron James for not standing still during US anthem
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday accused LeBron James of disrespecting the United States after the NBA star appeared to continue his warm-ups while the national anthem was performed before Philadelphia’s season opener on Tuesday. “I said right from the beginning that he’s no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE,” Trump said of James in a social media post sharing the video. “LeBron James should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag, and all that our...
items.titleZh: 特朗普抨击篮球明星勒布朗·詹姆斯在奏国歌时未站立
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普指责NBA球星勒布朗·詹姆斯在奏国歌时继续热身，称其行为不尊重美国。特朗普在社交媒体上要求詹姆斯向阵亡将士道歉。
items.whyImportant: 此事件再次引发了关于体育界人士在国歌仪式中表达政治立场及爱国主义定义的社会争议。

items.title: Trump tells Iowa rally crowd he encouraged Ramaswamy to keep running widely criticized campaign ad – as it happened
items.summary: This live blog is now closed. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在艾奥瓦州集会上称鼓励拉马斯瓦米继续投放备受争议的竞选广告
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在集会上表示支持拉马斯瓦米继续投放引发批评的竞选广告。与此同时，阿拉斯加州的参议员竞选正聚焦于生活成本危机。
items.whyImportant: 特朗普对争议性竞选策略的支持反映了其在党内竞选中的影响力及对舆论导向的掌控。

items.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine’s Starlink access amid Russia war
items.summary: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.
items.titleZh: 特朗普称马斯克在俄乌战争期间恢复了乌克兰的星链访问权限
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰在军事行动中依赖星链系统。尽管马斯克多次否认限制过访问权限，但特朗普公开声称其恢复了该服务。
items.whyImportant: 此言论涉及关键军事通信技术在冲突中的使用，并引发了关于马斯克在俄乌战争中角色及影响力的讨论。

items.title: Hong Kong degree holders’ pay advantage over non-graduates narrows to HK$2,500
items.summary: Fresh Hong Kong graduates are increasingly feeling the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) as they enter the workforce, human resources experts have said, after a survey found the starting salaries for degree holders and sub-degree graduates had narrowed. The results of the latest annual survey by Baptist University found the disparity between the starting salaries of bachelor’s degree and sub-degree graduates narrowed by 17 per cent, or HK$500 (US$63.70), from HK$3,000 last year to HK$2,500...
items.titleZh: 香港学位持有者与非学位持有者的薪资差距缩小至2500港元
items.summaryZh: 人力资源专家指出，人工智能对香港应届毕业生的就业市场产生了影响。浸会大学的年度调查显示，学士学位与副学位毕业生的起薪差距已从去年的3000港元缩小至2500港元。
items.whyImportant: 薪资差距的缩小反映了就业市场结构的变化以及人工智能对初级岗位薪酬水平的潜在影响。

items.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
items.summary: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.
items.titleZh: “这太卑鄙了”：艾米·阿克顿回应共和党对手利用其疏远母亲制作的攻击性广告
items.summaryZh: 共和党候选人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米发布了一则竞选广告，其中涉及阿克顿疏远的母亲。该母亲的丈夫曾被指控在阿克顿童年时期对其进行性虐待。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于竞选策略道德边界的讨论，并可能影响选民对候选人品格的看法。

items.title: El Salvador deploys special forces to Haiti after soldiers seized by gangs
items.summary: El Salvador deployed 100 special forces soldiers to Haiti on Thursday to help rescue four missing soldiers from the Central American country who recently came under attack by gangs, two officials told Associated Press. The special forces arrived a day after Salvadorean President Nayib Bukele announced a military operation to rescue the four aviation technicians, issuing an ultimatum directly to Haitian gang leaders in Creole. “We have a single objective: to bring our four compatriots back home...
items.titleZh: 萨尔瓦多向海地部署特种部队，此前四名士兵遭帮派扣押
items.summaryZh: 萨尔瓦多总统布克尔宣布开展军事行动，向海地派遣100名特种兵以营救四名被帮派扣押的航空技术人员。萨方已向海地帮派首领发出最后通牒，要求确保人员安全回国。
items.whyImportant: 此次跨境军事行动凸显了海地安全局势的恶化以及萨尔瓦多政府对保护海外公民的强硬立场。

items.titleZh: 如果特朗普在十一月落败会怎样？为您解答疑问——播客
items.summaryZh: 《卫报》播客探讨了特朗普若在选举中失利是否会接受结果，以及美国年轻人对中间派政治的态度。节目还讨论了美国在国际舞台上的形象恢复问题。
items.whyImportant: 该讨论反映了美国当前政治极化背景下，公众对选举公正性及国家未来走向的深层忧虑。

items.titleZh: 关于根据修订后的1950年《国防生产法》第303条，就国内石油生产、炼油和物流能力作出的总统决定
items.summaryZh: 美国总统发布备忘录，旨在根据《国防生产法》加强国内石油生产、炼油及物流能力。此举与2025年1月宣布的国家能源紧急状态相关。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示美国政府正通过动用战时法律手段，试图解决国内能源安全与供应保障问题。

items.title: Brazil’s election and the battle for the Amazon – podcast
items.summary: Our Latin America correspondent, Tom Phillips, heads to Roraima to hear what’s at stake for the rainforest and the communities that live there in the Brazilian presidential runoff on Sunday. Send your comments and questions to tif.questions@theguardian.com For the Amazon and the communities who live there, the stakes in Sunday’s Brazilian presidential election runoff could scarcely be higher. Our Latin America correspondent, Tom Phillips heads to Roraima, the country’s most northern state, to hear from voters, preachers and politicians in a region that heavily backed Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round. items.titleZh: 巴西大选与亚马逊雨林的争夺战——播客
items.summaryZh: 《卫报》记者前往巴西罗赖马州，探讨即将到来的总统大选决选对亚马逊雨林及当地社区的影响。该地区在首轮投票中曾大力支持博索纳罗。
items.whyImportant: 巴西大选的结果将直接决定亚马逊雨林的保护政策及全球气候治理的走向。

items.title: Australia sanctions 2 over North Korean fake IT workers scheme for nuclear funds
items.summary: Australia said on Friday it had sanctioned two North Korean individuals and companies over the use of “fraudulent” IT workers and cybercrime to earn cash for the isolated nuclear-armed state. The two men are alleged to be key operators in Pyongyang’s cybercriminal activities overseas, estimated by analysts to bring in billions for the country’s weapons programme. “The North Korean entities and individuals sanctioned today facilitate North Korea’s use of fraudulent IT workers to raise revenue for...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚制裁两名涉嫌为朝鲜核计划筹资的虚假IT工作者
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚宣布制裁两名朝鲜个人及相关实体，指控其利用虚假IT工作和网络犯罪为朝鲜核武器计划筹集资金。据分析，这些活动每年为朝鲜带来数十亿美元收入。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在切断朝鲜非法资金链，加大对朝鲜核武器开发计划的国际制裁压力。

items.title: ‘I’ve killed people’: Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly confessed to friend and asked for help cleaning ‘mess’, court told
items.summary: Friend tells jury Lamarre-Condon told him in early 2024 ‘I shot the first one through the head and the second one through the door’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly confessed to killing two men, telling his friend it was an “out-of-body experience”, before attempting to play it off as a joke, a court has been told. items.titleZh: 法庭获悉：博·拉马尔-康登据称向朋友承认“我杀人了”，并请求清理“烂摊子”
items.summaryZh: 法庭审理显示，前警官博·拉马尔-康登被控使用警用武器杀害两名男子。被告曾向朋友描述作案细节，并试图将其掩盖为玩笑。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉及警务人员暴力犯罪，在澳大利亚引发了关于警察权力与公共安全的广泛关注。

items.title: Rare Suu Kyi phone call to son signals shift in Myanmar junta strategy
items.summary: The son of Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi said she sounded “fairly healthy” after speaking to the detained ex-democratic leader on Thursday for the first time in more than five years. Suu Kyi, 81, is under house arrest in the capital, Naypyidaw, according to Myanmar authorities, where she has been sequestered since being unseated in a 2021 military coup. “She was sounding fairly healthy,” Kim Aris, who lives in the UK, said after the telephone conversation. items.titleZh: 昂山素季罕见致电其子，释放出缅甸军政府策略转变的信号
items.summaryZh: 被软禁五年多的缅甸前领导人昂山素季与其子进行了电话交谈，称其身体状况尚可。这是自2021年政变以来，她首次与外界亲属通话。
items.whyImportant: 此次通话可能暗示缅甸军政府在面对国际压力时，正尝试调整其对昂山素季的管控策略。
